title: pogostemon tetraphyllus
intro: Pogostemon tetraphyllus, commonly known as patchouli, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae, native to tropical Asia. The health benefits of patchouli include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of patchouli include its use in aromatherapy to promote relaxation and improve mood, as well as its application in traditional medicine to treat various skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of patchouli include patchoulol, pogostone, and other sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and fragrance.
